req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. The violation was that test[1] had kind='negative' but heuristic='EP'. The rule is that a negative test must not use EP (EP is reserved for positive equivalence partitions in this rule set). Fix: change test[1]'s heuristic from 'EP' to 'NEG', which correctly classifies it as a negative test using the NEG heuristic (invalid input class). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
Squad number 10 exists in the database
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid integer path segment
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 10
trace: R-PLAYER-037 — positive equivalence partition: integer segment must succeed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10

test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200()

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_response_body_on_422_contains_detail
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
actions: Send GET /players/squadnumber/notanumber with a non-integer path segment
Inspect the response body for FastAPI validation error structure
expected: Response JSON contains 'detail' key with validation error information
trace: R-PLAYER-037 — NEG + exact-value: asserts both status code 422 and presence of 'detail' in body to catch mutations that change status code or suppress error body
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_by_squad_number_response_body_on_422_contains_detail():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/notanumber')
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert isinstance(body['detail'], list)
    assert len(body['detail']) >= 1
